businesses.business: mobile power generation and equipment rental for oilfield and data centers

offering_description.value: Provides mobile gas-turbine and reciprocating power generation fleets, rented on contract to data centers, utilities and industrial customers. Also manufactures and rents proppant-handling equipment (mobile storage and conveyance systems) to oil and gas well completion operators. Equipment is built at its own facilities and deployed and serviced by company crews.

primary_products.value: mobile power generation units; proppant storage and handling systems

primary_services.value: on-site power generation; equipment rental and field logistics; equipment maintenance and operation

customer_segment.value: B2B: data center developers, utilities, industrial users, oil and gas exploration and production and pressure pumping companies

end_markets.value: data centers; electric power; oil and gas; industrial

revenue_model.value: rental or leasing: contracted monthly fees for power generation fleets and proppant-handling systems; service fees: field services, logistics and operating support; product sales: occasional sales of manufactured equipment
revenue_model.category: rental or leasing; service fees; product sales

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and operates mobile power fleets and proppant systems rented to data center, utility and energy customers; OEM / manufacturer: assembles proppant handling equipment using purchased components

geography_served.value: US national: Permian Basin and other US shale basins, data center and power sites across the United States

specialization.value: related lines: mobile power generation and proppant handling equipment, both rented to energy-related customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: long-term contracts directly with data center, utility and oilfield customers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: air emissions permitting for power generation turbines (EPA, state agencies), workplace safety and oilfield rules

notes: Recently shifted from mainly proppant logistics to mostly power generation; mix and details may have changed.
